note: Provider news/changelog sources polled by scripts/discover.mjs to DISCOVER new announcements (vs scripts/fetch.mjs which only detects changes to known pricing pages). format 'rss' parses an RSS/Atom feed; format 'html' scrapes article links matching link_pattern off a server-rendered index page (base resolves relative links). Only verified, working sources are listed; confirm a source actually returns items before adding it. Providers still uncovered are recorded in 'no_feed' so the gap is visible.

no_feed.why: Blog (perplexity.ai/hub) is a JS-rendered Framer site that returns no scrapeable article links to plain HTTP, and exposes no RSS. Needs a headed-browser fetch (the watch path) or a third-party mirror; left out of discovery until a plain-HTTP source is found.

x.ai/news is server-rendered and scrapeable via curl, but Cloudflare returns 403 to Node's plain fetch (same block that keeps OpenAI's pages on the headed-browser watch path). The daily discovery job uses plain fetch, so it can't poll this; revisit if a non-Cloudflare mirror or feed appears, or route via the headed-browser path.
